answer_text:
Here are reliable places to order an **Eid beauty gift** across the **GCC (UAE, KSA, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman)**, with good gifting options (sets, bundles, gift wrap, same/next‑day delivery in many cases):

## Multi‑brand beauty retailers (best for curated gift sets)
- **Sephora Middle East** (UAE/KSA/Kuwait/Qatar/Bahrain/Oman): gift sets, fragrances, gift cards, fast delivery in major cities.  
  https://www.sephora.ae / https://www.sephora.sa (varies by country)
- **Faces / Wojooh** (strong GCC coverage): perfumes + makeup sets, often Eid promotions and gift wrapping.  
  https://www.faces.com
- **Boots** (UAE/KSA): skincare & wellness gifts, value bundles.  
  https://www.boots.ae (UAE) / https://www.boots.com.sa (KSA)

## Perfume-focused (popular Eid gifts)
- **Ounass** (UAE + delivers to GCC): luxury fragrances/beauty, premium packaging, fast delivery.  
  https://www.ounass.ae
- **V Perfumes** (UAE; ships regionally on some items): big range + discounts.  
  https://www.vperfumes.com
- **Ajmal Perfumes** (wide GCC presence): classic Eid-friendly gift sets.  
  https://www.ajmal.com
- **Arabian Oud** (GCC): oud & fragrance gift sets.  
  https://www.arabianoud.com
- **Laverne** (very popular in KSA/GCC): gifting sets and seasonal bundles.  
  https://laverne.com

## Department stores & luxury beauty (high-end gifting)
- **Harrods (Middle East delivery options via website)** / **Selfridges (international)**: best for luxury sets if delivery timing works.
- **Boutique brand sites** (e.g., Dior, Chanel, Jo Malone, Armani Beauty): often offer gift wrap; availability varies by country.

## Quick delivery marketplaces (good for last-minute)
- **Noon** (UAE/KSA): beauty gift sets + fast delivery options.  
  https://www.noon.com
- **Amazon** (Amazon.ae / Amazon.sa): huge selection; check seller ratings and “Fulfilled by Amazon.”  
  https://www.amazon.ae / https://www.amazon.sa
- **Talabat / Deliveroo “shops”** (in some cities): for same-day beauty/fragrance from local partners.

---

### To recommend the best option, tell me:
1) **Country/city** (e.g., Dubai, Riyadh, Doha)  
2) **Budget** (e.g., under 200 AED/SAR, 500, 1000+)  
3) **Recipient preference** (perfume, skincare, makeup, “clean” beauty, oud)  
4) **Delivery deadline** (same day / next day / before Eid)

And I’ll shortlist 3–5 specific gifts with links that deliver to your location.
query_text: Where can I order an Eid beauty gift in the GCC?
